name: arduino-project
description: Create an Arduino/embedded project with sensor integration
request_pattern: Create an Arduino project that ${project_purpose}. Include: main sketch (.ino), sensor library wrappers, serial debug output, LED status indicators, power-saving sleep mode, and a README with wiring diagram (text-based) and parts list.

variables.project_purpose: reads temperature and humidity from a DHT22 sensor and displays on an OLED screen
